title: Shortest Subarray With OR at Least K I
summary: Given an array of non-negative integers and an integer k, find the minimum length of a contiguous subarray whose bitwise OR of elements is at least k.
statement: Given an array of non-negative integers and an integer k, find the minimum length of a contiguous subarray whose bitwise OR of elements is at least k. If no such subarray exists, return -1.
constraints: Its value is the bitwise OR of all contained elements.
Return the minimum length whose OR is at least k, or -1 if none exists.
hints: Fix every possible starting index under the source-I constraints.
Extend right while accumulating OR, whose set bits can only increase.
